about: Squidward Scaring the Fish Family is a SpongeBob SquarePants frame where Squidward comes loping across the sand with a manic, toothy grin, arms swinging, while a tall fish mother in the foreground gapes in horror and pulls her two small children close. Everything about his body language says he is thrilled to see them, and everything about theirs says they want to be anywhere else. The image is used for unwanted enthusiasm: someone barging into a space where they are dreaded, an overeager coworker, a relative heading for the kids' table, or a bug report arriving five minutes before the weekend.
usage:
This one has three boxes. The top box is the situation caption on the white strip above the picture. The second sits over Squidward and names whoever (or whatever) is rushing in. The third sits over the fish family and names the people who want no part of it.

It is funniest when the arrival is cheerful and the victims are clearly outnumbered or trapped. Think family gatherings, office kitchens, multiplayer lobbies, school group chats. The label over Squidward can be a person, but objects work too: "Monday", "the 6am alarm", "a surprise audit".
